summary: Iteration 7 backend and frontend testing completed against the public URL. Sequential availability rules, Returned/custom-code exceptions, update conflict handling, schedule/scoping/totals, stock-filtered revenue, BNG/KLN prefixes, CRUD regressions, login hint removal, branch-aware bill UX, overlap toast/dialog behavior, stock schedule UI, and mobile layout passed. One critical race remains: concurrent overlapping creates admitted two bookings in both runs (2/2 reproduction).

critical.issue: Overlap enforcement is not atomic. Eight simultaneous creates for one stock and identical 2026-08-20..2026-08-25 dates produced two HTTP 200 bookings and six 409 responses in both the initial run and retry, so real concurrent users can double-book stock.

minor.issue: Rejected overlap attempts consume auto bill numbers because next_bill_no runs before conflict validation; failed 409 requests therefore create branch sequence gaps.

ui_bugs.issue: Recharts repeatedly logs that ResponsiveContainer width/height are -1 while dashboard/stock routes mount. Charts rendered after layout in tested desktop/mobile flows, so this is non-blocking but indicates unstable initial measurement.

action_items: Make conflict-check plus booking insert atomic/serialized per stock; for example, transactionally update a per-stock lock/version document before rechecking and inserting, or reserve each occupied stock/date under a unique index.
Apply the same serialization strategy to availability-relevant booking updates so concurrent create/update operations cannot race.
Run next_bill_no only after availability validation, or allocate the number inside the same atomic commit, if branch bill sequences must not contain conflict-generated gaps.
Add a stable min-width/min-height or defer Recharts rendering until its parent has measurable dimensions to remove negative-size warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: check_stock_conflict performs a read followed by a separate insert/update with no transaction, lock, unique reservation constraint, or compare-and-swap; this is a confirmed TOCTOU race, not a theoretical concern.
create_booking increments the branch counter before stock validation/conflict detection, so every rejected overlap burns a bill number.
server.py is 1,353 lines, above the 700-line maintainability threshold; availability, stock schedule, bookings, and stats should be split into focused routers/services.

success_rate.backend: 89% (8/9 scenarios passed; concurrency failure reproduced 2/2 runs)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested functional flows passed on desktop; stock schedule also passed at 390x844, with one non-blocking chart console warning

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_I7_-prefixed stock and booking records, including concurrent overlap attempts and one isolated UI stock/booking. All test-created records were cleaned up; pre-existing JS-001 / BNG-0021 was only read.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run test_iteration7_availability.py, especially test_concurrent_overlapping_creates_allow_exactly_one_booking. Current failure consistently yields two successful overlapping bookings out of eight. Sequential overlap and all requested UI flows pass. Browser's first comprehensive script had a test-only SVG selector assertion failure after the schedule was visibly correct; corrected retry passed using the responsive-container selector.
rca_of_the_issue: create_booking awaits check_stock_conflict and later performs insert_one as separate operations. Concurrent requests can all read no conflict before either insert becomes visible, then multiple inserts succeed. Reproduced twice with eight parallel requests; each run persisted exactly two overlapping active bookings. The bill counter is incremented even earlier, which independently explains sequence gaps on every rejected request.
